nodes.text: Massage du dos à l’aromathérapie cet après-midi, un soin complémentaire très attendu qui m’éloigne du stress de l’hôpital.

nodes.source: Feeling a bit better, I can smell dinner and will try to get some of it inside me now. Managed most of my dinner.
nodes.text: Un peu mieux : je sens le dîner et vais essayer d’en manger. J’en ai finalement mangé presque tout.

nodes.source: Quite a few visitors came tonight which tired me out somewhat. Chemotherapy carried on into the early hours and the ward was noisy tonight so sleep will be difficult.
nodes.text: Beaucoup de visiteurs ce soir, ce qui m’a fatigué. La chimio se prolonge aux petites heures et le service est bruyant : dormir sera difficile.

nodes.source: 3rd February 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 3 février 2005 - jeudi

nodes.source: Woke after a very disturbed sleep. Managed to get up for some breakfast.
nodes.text: Réveil après une nuit très perturbée. J’ai réussi à me lever pour le petit-déjeuner.

nodes.source: The rest of the day I spent in bed, feeling very nauseous. On occasion, mostly when I went in to the very 'unclean' and smelly patient toilet on my ward, this would cause me to heave and sometimes to be sick.
nodes.text: Le reste de la journée au lit, très nauséeux. Les toilettes des patients, très sales et malodorantes, me donnaient surtout des haut-le-cœur et parfois des vomissements.

nodes.source: Couldn't face any lunch.
nodes.text: Impossible d’envisager le déjeuner.

nodes.source: Chemotherapy started at around the same time as yesterday, possibly a little earlier in order for me to be free earlier for sleep. I wasn't aware of much, I had my good moments, mostly after being sick but it soon turned bad again and I was in and out of sleep all day.
nodes.text: Début de la chimiothérapie à peu près comme hier, peut-être un peu plus tôt pour dormir plus vite. Je n’étais guère conscient de ce qui se passait. Quelques bons moments après avoir vomi, puis le malaise revenait. J’ai somnolé toute la journée.

nodes.source: This week so far has been much harder than previous weeks. A female friend has been to see me several times this week, the female company with a little added TLC has really made all the difference.
nodes.text: Cette semaine est bien plus dure que les précédentes. Une amie est venue plusieurs fois. Sa compagnie et un peu de tendresse ont vraiment tout changé.

nodes.source: Couldn't face any dinner. Ken prepared another plate of fruit for me, which I ate most of and managed to digest before being sick again later on!
nodes.text: Impossible de dîner. Ken m’a préparé encore des fruits ; j’en ai mangé et digéré la plupart avant de vomir de nouveau plus tard !

nodes.source: Developed a mild headache and was given 500mg of Paracetamol.
nodes.text: Léger mal de tête, traité par 500 mg de paracétamol.

nodes.source: Got free of the chemotherapy drip at a reasonable hour and got my head down for as best a night's sleep as I could muster. During the night I woke feeling nauseous, I hadn't taken my anti sickness tablets from earlier, so stayed awake for a while until I felt like I could manage a sip of water and got the tablets inside me, 2 Domperidome and 1 Ciprofloxacin.
nodes.text: Débranché à une heure raisonnable, j’ai essayé de dormir au mieux. Réveil nocturne avec des nausées : je n’avais pas pris les antiémétiques plus tôt. J’ai attendu de pouvoir avaler une gorgée d’eau pour prendre deux comprimés de dompéridone et un de ciprofloxacine.

nodes.source: 4th February 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 4 février 2005 - vendredi

nodes.source: Woke up feeling a little better and managed a bowl of cornflakes. This feeling didn't last long and I retired to bed feeling much the same as the previous day.
nodes.text: Un peu mieux au réveil, j’ai mangé des cornflakes. Cela n’a pas duré : retour au lit, dans le même état qu’hier.

nodes.source: Couldn't face lunch.
nodes.text: Impossible de déjeuner.

nodes.source: The day went slowly, chemotherapy started late although I had agreed to have it started earlier.
nodes.text: Journée lente, chimiothérapie commencée tard malgré mon accord pour débuter plus tôt.

nodes.source: Couldn't face dinner.
nodes.text: Impossible de dîner.

nodes.source: Finally got away for home at 22.00. Once home I had a bath and went to bed!
nodes.text: Enfin parti à 22 h. À la maison, un bain et au lit !

nodes.source: 5th February 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 5 février 2005 - samedi

nodes.source: Woke up after a long and undisturbed sleep. Felt much better than any of the mornings last week.
nodes.text: Réveil après une longue nuit tranquille. Bien mieux que tous les matins de la semaine passée.

nodes.source: Managed some breakfast and took my correct medication, 1 Granisetron and 2 Domperidome tablets.
nodes.text: Petit-déjeuner et traitement correct : un granisétron et deux comprimés de dompéridone.

nodes.source: A friend popped over and I decided (after a little convincing) to go out locally for a Pizza Express. Ken, my friend and I hit the Hampton Court Pizza Express for a little while. I managed a bit of a starter and the majority of my main course. Straight home after.
nodes.text: Une amie est passée et m’a un peu convaincu d’aller au Pizza Express du coin. Avec Ken, nous avons choisi Hampton Court. J’ai mangé un peu d’entrée et presque tout le plat principal. Puis retour direct.

nodes.source: Just been relaxing for the rest of the day, haven't really been hungry but feeling much better. Managed to update this diary with entries for the past few days.
nodes.text: Repos le reste de la journée. Peu faim, mais bien mieux. J’ai rattrapé les derniers jours du journal.

nodes.source: This evening I've had another mild headache, so I've taken another 500mg of Paracetamol which seems to have done the trick.
nodes.text: Encore un léger mal de tête ce soir ; 500 mg de paracétamol semblent l’avoir réglé.

nodes.source: Not sure if I'll have a snack or not tonight. I'm going to concentrate on trying to eat a little something before I go to bed. I think my body is looking forward more to another long and undisturbed sleep instead of food!
nodes.text: Je ne sais pas si je prendrai un en-cas. Je vais essayer de manger un peu avant de dormir. Mon corps attend surtout une longue nuit tranquille plutôt que de la nourriture !

nodes.source: Until tomorrow...
nodes.text: À demain...

nodes.source: 6th February 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 6 février 2005 - dimanche

nodes.source: Another long sleep and a very lazy morning lying in bed. Felt OK when I woke, although a little nauseous, or perhaps hungry, I couldn't determine which.
nodes.text: Encore une longue nuit et une matinée très paresseuse au lit. Au réveil, plutôt bien, mais un peu nauséeux, ou affamé, difficile de distinguer.

nodes.source: I've taken my medication (1 Granisetron and 2 Domperidome tablets) late today (about 14.00) and haven't eaten as yet.
nodes.text: Médicaments pris tard, vers 14 h : un granisétron et deux dompéridones. Je n’ai pas encore mangé.

nodes.source: Not planning anything today apart from possibly going over to see my Mum later on this evening if I feel up to it. Apparently she's been invited out at last however, if she cannot make it, I'm sure she'll be left indoors alone with no family visits. The only local family she has apart from me is my brother and it's really been playing on my mind on how much he has been looking out for her whilst I have been unable to. Not a lot by all accounts.
nodes.text: Rien de prévu, sauf peut-être voir ma mère ce soir si j’en ai la force. Elle est enfin invitée quelque part, mais si elle ne peut pas y aller, elle restera sûrement seule sans visite familiale. Le seul autre membre de la famille vivant à proximité est mon frère. Je me demande beaucoup combien il s’est occupé d’elle pendant mon absence. Apparemment, pas beaucoup.

nodes.source: Had a little something to eat for an early dinner.
nodes.text: Un peu mangé pour un dîner tôt.

nodes.source: Went over to see my Mum this evening for a few hours. I arrived to find her well and downstairs but her cheek was all swollen on one side. This has happened before, possibly an abscess. It took me a while to convince her to make sure she again calls the Doctor about this as soon as possible, despite an upcoming X-Ray appointment, she has been waiting three months for! I have seen so much varied Cancer at the hospital on both young and old, male and female, it frightens me to think what the outcome of my Mum's X-Ray will bring.
nodes.text: Quelques heures chez ma mère ce soir. Elle allait bien, au rez-de-chaussée, mais un côté de sa joue était gonflé. Déjà arrivé, peut-être un abcès. J’ai dû insister pour qu’elle rappelle rapidement le médecin, malgré une radiographie à venir attendue depuis trois mois ! J’ai vu tant de cancers différents à l’hôpital, chez des jeunes, des vieux, des hommes et des femmes, que ses résultats me font peur.

nodes.source: Despite my treatment going very well, this weekend is the first time I have had thoughts such as "will I make it to see the end of this year", stupid I know but I want to be totally honest here in this diary. Guess I'm just scared and this past week has taken its toll on me mentally as well as physically.
nodes.text: Bien que mon traitement se passe très bien, ce week-end, pour la première fois, j’ai pensé : « Verrai-je la fin de l’année ? » C’est idiot, mais je veux être totalement honnête. Je suis simplement effrayé et cette semaine m’a éprouvé autant mentalement que physiquement.

nodes.source: I returned home, made myself a little more to eat and relaxed in front of the TV until the early hours. During the course of the evening that mild headache crept back up on me for what must be the third night running, I'm not sure what's causing them? Another 500mg of Paracetamol and I went to bed.
nodes.text: Rentré, j’ai encore mangé un peu et regardé la télévision jusqu’aux petites heures. Le léger mal de tête est revenu, sans doute pour la troisième soirée consécutive. Quelle en est la cause ? Encore 500 mg de paracétamol, puis au lit.

nodes.source: 7th February 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 7 février 2005 - lundi

nodes.source: Woke up feeling fine and hungry this morning. Quite early (09:30) considering I didn't go to bed until 02:30. Hopefully that'll mean an early night tonight, in readiness for treatment tomorrow.
nodes.text: Réveil en forme et affamé à 9 h 30, assez tôt après un coucher à 2 h 30. Espérons un coucher tôt ce soir pour préparer le traitement de demain.

nodes.source: Managed some cleaning around my house, had a visit from a good friend and then a bite to eat, off to the supermarket and briefly to my Mum's house again.
nodes.text: Un peu de ménage, la visite d’un bon ami, un repas, le supermarché et encore une brève visite à ma mère.

nodes.source: I feel almost normal today! Unfortunately it doesn't last long, I'm getting very tired quickly these days and it's treatment day tomorrow.
nodes.text: Presque normal aujourd’hui ! Cela ne dure malheureusement pas : je me fatigue vite et demain, c’est traitement.

nodes.source: Had a blow-out dinner this evening which Ken kindly prepared for me.
nodes.text: Un énorme dîner préparé gentiment par Ken.

nodes.source: Off to bed soon, dreaded hospital day tomorrow.
nodes.text: Bientôt au lit, demain cette journée d’hôpital que je redoute.

nodes.source: 8th February 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 8 février 2005 - mardi

nodes.source: Felt really exhausted when I woke up today. Blew my nose before getting ready and developed a nose bleed, this is a worry especially when my platelets could be low. I managed to stop it quite quickly but it worried me somewhat. After a quick breakfast, Ken and I braved the traffic to the hospital, it wasn't very easy today, the roads were full.
nodes.text: Épuisé au réveil. En me mouchant, j’ai déclenché un saignement de nez, inquiétant si mes plaquettes sont basses. Il s’est arrêté vite, mais m’a préoccupé. Après un petit-déjeuner rapide, Ken et moi avons affronté une circulation très dense vers l’hôpital.

nodes.source: These problems I had this morning caused me to arrive at the Hospital quite late. My blood test was taken almost immediately, but due to my unavoidable lateness there was insufficient time to squeeze in receiving my blood results along with my 6 hours of chemotherapy. Therefore it was decided that it would be best all round to have my chemotherapy treatment postponed until tomorrow.
nodes.text: Ces problèmes m’ont fait arriver tard. Prise de sang presque immédiate, mais il ne restait pas assez de temps pour les résultats et six heures de chimiothérapie. Le mieux était donc de reporter le traitement à demain.

nodes.source: One day off schedule will not however make any difference to my health stakes.
nodes.text: Un décalage d’un jour ne changera toutefois rien à mes chances.

nodes.source: Once my blood test results were back it appeared that my earlier worry of a low platelet count was in fact unfounded. It turns out they have risen back to completely normal levels for the moment. However, and confirming my tiredness of this morning, my red blood count and haemoglobin levels are starting to fall in to the "we're concerned" range. A possible blood transfusion was mentioned! I will now be watching these levels carefully along with all the other counts from my blood tests that I have so far learned about.
nodes.text: Les résultats ont dissipé mon inquiétude : les plaquettes sont revenues à la normale. En revanche, globules rouges et hémoglobine descendent dans la zone « préoccupante », ce qui explique ma fatigue. Une transfusion a été évoquée ! Je vais désormais suivre ces valeurs avec les autres que j’ai appris à connaître.

nodes.source: In order to maximise my time at the hospital, it was arranged that an upcoming EDTA test be moved forward to today. This meant a bit of necessary hanging around and I was out of the Hospital by 16:30.
nodes.text: Pour profiter de ma présence, on a avancé le test EDTA prévu prochainement à aujourd’hui. Encore de l’attente, puis sortie à 16 h 30.

nodes.source: Straight home for a huge dinner kindly prepared by Ken and several pancakes for afters! I've been quite tired all day and once dinner had suitably gone down I got myself an early night in readiness for hospital tomorrow.
nodes.text: Retour pour un énorme dîner de Ken et plusieurs crêpes en dessert ! Fatigué toute la journée, je me suis couché tôt une fois le repas digéré, pour l’hôpital demain.

nodes.source: 9th February 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 9 février 2005 - mercredi

nodes.source: Awoke still feeling tired. Although it was hard, I managed to motivate myself to get up and get ready for hospital. I had a clear 8 hours sleep last night but I'm still tired.
nodes.text: Encore fatigué au réveil malgré huit heures pleines. Difficile, mais j’ai réussi à me motiver pour me lever et partir à l’hôpital.

nodes.source: Got to the hospital, no time for Emla cream today, straight into cannulation which took 3 attempts to take this morning.
nodes.text: Pas le temps pour l’Emla : pose directe du cathéter, avec trois tentatives.

nodes.source: Once my treatment was under way I was feeling quite a chill and asked the nurse to cover me with blankets. Managed to doze off for practically the rest of the day until my 6 hour treatment was finished.
nodes.text: Une fois le traitement commencé, j’avais très froid et ai demandé des couvertures. J’ai somnolé presque tout le reste des six heures.

nodes.source: So much sleep! Has to be down to the fact that I have a very low red blood count and haemoglobin level.
nodes.text: Tant de sommeil ! Cela doit venir de mes globules rouges et de mon hémoglobine très bas.

nodes.source: Once home, hit the sofa for more sleep! I haven't managed much to eat tonight and will soon retire to bed. Hopefully tomorrow I will be a little livelier as I have a plane to catch in the evening.
nodes.text: À la maison, canapé et encore sommeil ! Peu mangé et bientôt au lit. Espérons plus d’énergie demain : j’ai un avion à prendre le soir.

nodes.source: Night.
nodes.text: Bonne nuit.

nodes.source: 10th February 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 10 février 2005 - jeudi

nodes.source: Woke up after a good night's sleep and feeling much better than yesterday. A lot of things to do today.
nodes.text: Bonne nuit et bien mieux qu’hier au réveil. Beaucoup à faire.

nodes.source: Yesterday I left the hospital in a daze tired and exhausted; and forgot to pick up my GCSF injections from the hospital pharmacy. I need to start these injections today so another visit to the hospital is required.
nodes.text: Hier, en quittant l’hôpital épuisé et dans le brouillard, j’ai oublié mes injections de G-CSF à la pharmacie. Je dois les commencer aujourd’hui, donc il faut y retourner.

nodes.source: Managed to complete a little work on a laptop this morning, it's ready to drop off to the owner now so I can fit that in today along with the visit to the hospital, dropping in to see my Mum and catching the plane tonight!
nodes.text: J’ai terminé une petite réparation de portable, prêt à rendre. Je dois caser sa livraison, l’hôpital, une visite à ma mère et mon avion ce soir !

nodes.source: Ken came along with me today although I did most of the driving; managed to pickup my injections, drop off the laptop (took my first injection at this point) and get home just in time to eat and get ready for my flight.
nodes.text: Ken m’a accompagné, mais j’ai conduit presque tout le temps. Injections récupérées, portable livré, première injection à ce moment-là, puis retour juste à temps pour manger et préparer le vol.

nodes.source: Picked up some more clothes from my Mum's house en route to the airport.
nodes.text: J’ai récupéré d’autres vêtements chez ma mère en allant à l’aéroport.

nodes.source: Arrived at Heathrow in good time for my flight only to find out it had been cancelled (supposed technical problems)! They offered to fly me to Manchester and coach me to Leeds/Bradford (my original destination). I called my friends in Leeds and it made little difference to their travel time to pick me up from either airport, so Manchester it was.
nodes.text: Arrivé à Heathrow à temps, j’ai découvert l’annulation du vol pour un supposé problème technique. On m’a proposé Manchester puis un car vers Leeds/Bradford, ma destination initiale. Pour mes amis de Leeds, venir me chercher à l’un ou l’autre changeait peu la route. Direction Manchester.

nodes.source: Didn't expect any problems flying, although the walk to the gate tired me out. I had a brief wait to catch my breath as the plane was a little late in departing.
nodes.text: Je ne prévoyais pas de problème en avion, même si marcher jusqu’à la porte m’a épuisé. Le léger retard du départ m’a permis de reprendre mon souffle.

nodes.source: Domestic flights are so quick, as soon as you have ascended it seems that you begin descent and final approach.
nodes.text: Les vols intérieurs sont si courts : à peine monté, on commence déjà la descente et l’approche finale.

nodes.source: My friends were waiting for me as soon as I appeared through the arrival doors and we were on our way to Leeds in a flash.
nodes.text: Mes amis m’attendaient dès la sortie des arrivées et nous avons vite pris la route de Leeds.

nodes.source: Relaxed and chatted for a bit, got to bed about 01:00.
nodes.text: Un peu de détente et de discussion, au lit vers 1 h.

nodes.source: 11th February 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 11 février 2005 - vendredi

nodes.source: Had a really nice sleep and a lazy morning.
nodes.text: Très bonne nuit et matinée paresseuse.

nodes.source: A nice breakfast and some really tasty soup for lunch. My appetite seems to have returned quite adequately.
nodes.text: Bon petit-déjeuner et délicieuse soupe au déjeuner. L’appétit est bien revenu.

nodes.source: Went for a drive in and around Leeds for a while to get out for a bit. I am still feeling quite tired and not really motivated for much at all, one of the reasons I haven't updated my diary in a couple of days.
nodes.text: Petit tour en voiture dans Leeds et les environs pour sortir. Toujours très fatigué et peu motivé, d’où mon silence dans le journal depuis deux jours.

nodes.source: Returned back to base for the second of my GCSF injections which I did myself! Chose the stomach location and managed to stick myself with the needle. It wasn't too pleasant to do but needs must!
nodes.text: Retour pour la deuxième injection de G-CSF, que j’ai faite moi-même ! Dans le ventre : j’ai réussi à enfoncer l’aiguille. Pas très agréable, mais il le fallait !

nodes.source: Had a wonderful dinner, watched the box, relaxed and chatted for most of the evening.
nodes.text: Excellent dîner, télévision, détente et discussions presque toute la soirée.

nodes.source: After a bath I got to bed around 00.00.
nodes.text: Un bain, puis au lit vers minuit.

nodes.source: 12th February 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 12 février 2005 - samedi

nodes.source: Another good sleep and a lazy morning. I've had breakfast so the appetite is still there.
nodes.text: Encore une bonne nuit et une matinée tranquille. Petit-déjeuner pris : l’appétit est toujours là.

nodes.source: It's the Cirque du Soliel show night tonight in Manchester, going to try to conserve my energy all day today, so I can feel good for the journey to Manchester and enjoy the show.
nodes.text: Spectacle du Cirque du Soleil ce soir à Manchester. Je vais économiser mes forces pour le trajet et pour en profiter.

nodes.source: Arrived at The Trafford Centre in good time for the show, feeling OK. I got a sneak look at the Trafford shopping centre, never been there before; quite impressed! I'll have to pay it a visit when I'm better.
nodes.text: Arrivé au Trafford Centre à temps et plutôt bien. Premier aperçu du centre commercial, très impressionnant ! J’y reviendrai quand j’irai mieux.

nodes.source: The show was fantastic (as expected), I enjoyed every minute of it and was glad that, although tough, I had made the effort to visit my friends and go to the show (with a little help from them of course).
nodes.text: Spectacle fantastique, comme prévu. J’ai savouré chaque minute et suis heureux d’avoir fait l’effort de venir voir mes amis et d’y aller, avec leur aide bien sûr.

nodes.source: Once back to Leeds, I was soon ready for bed. I found the whole thing quite tiring.
nodes.text: De retour à Leeds, j’étais vite prêt pour le lit. Tout cela m’a beaucoup fatigué.

nodes.source: 13th February 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 13 février 2005 - dimanche

nodes.source: Woke up at 06:00 feeling nauseous; managed to ignore the feeling and get some more sleep. Once I got up, it wasn't long before I was sick. Strange, as I had only been feeling tired over the preceding days. I think it might be something to do with the fact that I ate a whole box of popcorn the night before. Oh and half a bag of liquorice!
nodes.text: Réveil à 6 h avec des nausées. J’ai réussi à les ignorer et redormir, mais peu après m’être levé, j’ai vomi. Étrange, car ces derniers jours je n’étais que fatigué. Peut-être la boîte entière de pop-corn d’hier soir, et le demi-sachet de réglisse !

nodes.source: Once up and about, I didn't really fancy any food at all and just curled up in my chair and watched the box.
nodes.text: Une fois levé, aucune envie de manger. Je me suis recroquevillé dans mon fauteuil devant la télévision.

nodes.source: My Aunt and Uncle paid me a visit and saw me change from feeling quite sick to perking up quite a bit. I was sick again in the afternoon; felt a lot better after. Soon after they left I started to feel tired again and had some doubt whether I would make my flight home.
nodes.text: Ma tante et mon oncle sont venus et m’ont vu passer de très nauséeux à bien plus en forme. J’ai encore vomi l’après-midi, puis me suis senti mieux. Après leur départ, la fatigue est revenue et j’ai douté de pouvoir prendre mon avion.

nodes.source: Had a sleep for an hour or so and pushed myself to get packed and ready for the flight. All day I had only managed some water, Lucozade and a sliced apple, as I just didn't feel right at all.
nodes.text: Une heure de sommeil, puis je me suis forcé à préparer mes affaires. Toute la journée, seulement de l’eau, du Lucozade et une pomme en tranches : je n’étais vraiment pas bien.

nodes.source: I had a great but relaxed weekend with some very caring and close friends. It was hard for me to say good-bye at the airport, I could have cried easily. I had such a nice time and also did not want to face what I knew I was coming back to.
nodes.text: Un excellent week-end reposant avec des amis proches et très attentionnés. Les quitter à l’aéroport a été difficile, j’aurais facilement pleuré. J’avais passé de si bons moments et redoutais aussi ce qui m’attendait au retour.

nodes.source: I was soon up in the clouds and headed for Heathrow. Ken was there waiting to pick me up and I was ready for and waiting to hit my bed. I was exhausted.
nodes.text: Bientôt dans les nuages, direction Heathrow. Ken m’attendait. Je n’avais qu’une envie : mon lit. Épuisé.

nodes.source: 14th February 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 14 février 2005 - lundi

nodes.source: Woke up feeling OK. Lazed around for a bit then got up and got myself some breakfast. At least my appetite has returned.
nodes.text: Réveil correct, un peu de paresse puis petit-déjeuner. Au moins, l’appétit est revenu.

nodes.source: Still lazed around, taking it very easy as I'm still getting tired out quite quickly. Tomorrow's blood test will most likely confirm my red blood count and haemoglobin levels are still low. This could possibly mean a requirement for a blood transfusion sometime this week. I'm not really keen on it, not sure why, it just doesn't appeal to me!
nodes.text: Toujours au ralenti, car je me fatigue très vite. L’analyse de demain confirmera probablement globules rouges et hémoglobine bas. Peut-être une transfusion cette semaine. Cela ne me plaît pas, sans trop savoir pourquoi !

nodes.source: Time to reflect on my weekend away today, like I said a brilliant time but I certainly pushed myself to get there, be on my best and get back! I still think I needed to get away, so I'm really glad I did it.
nodes.text: Je repense à ce superbe week-end. J’ai dû vraiment me pousser pour partir, en profiter et revenir ! J’avais besoin de m’évader, je suis donc heureux de l’avoir fait.

nodes.source: It also occurred to me today that the 2 month marker - since I was diagnosed - escaped a mention in my diary on the 9th of this month. Time has passed so quickly recently; I've been tired, fed up and I have so much ahead of me with extra operations being mentioned and blood transfusions, my mind is all over the place.
nodes.text: J’ai aussi réalisé avoir oublié de mentionner les deux mois du diagnostic le 9. Le temps file. Entre fatigue, ras-le-bol, nouvelles opérations et transfusions évoquées, j’ai l’esprit dans tous les sens.

nodes.source: The day soon flashed by, once I'd had a long bath I was ready for an evening in front of the box.
nodes.text: La journée a filé. Après un long bain, j’étais prêt pour une soirée télévision.

nodes.source: Had a light dinner of soup and bread, I haven't really eaten as well as I should have but my tiredness doesn't allow me much energy to do anything else.
nodes.text: Dîner léger, soupe et pain. Je n’ai pas mangé aussi bien que je devrais, mais la fatigue ne me laisse guère d’énergie.

nodes.source: Ready to hit the sack soon, hospital tomorrow and the apprehension is building already. I'm getting fed up with it, but I have no choice, so soldiering on is my only option.
nodes.text: Bientôt au lit. Hôpital demain, l’appréhension monte déjà. J’en ai assez, mais je n’ai pas le choix : continuer, encore.

nodes.source: It has been a hectic weekend and I've not been feeling great, apologies for those of you that missed out on my regular diary updates. Oh, and in case you were wondering, I didn't get any Valentines, nor did I send any!!
nodes.text: Week-end chargé et mauvaise forme : désolé pour ceux à qui les nouvelles régulières ont manqué. Et si vous vous le demandiez, aucune carte de Saint-Valentin reçue ni envoyée !!

nodes.source: 15th February 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 15 février 2005 - mardi

nodes.source: Woke up feeling OK, although still tired. After a palaver in the bathroom with a nose bleed, a painful experience on the loo and feeling exhausted, I finally got myself together for the hospital.
nodes.text: Réveil plutôt correct, mais toujours fatigué. Après un saignement de nez, un passage douloureux aux toilettes et un grand épuisement, j’ai enfin réussi à me préparer.

nodes.source: Once I arrived at hospital, pretty much the same happened as the previous Tuesday. I was late and told that my treatment could not be carried out until tomorrow. A blood test was taken and I waited just over an hour for the results to come through.
nodes.text: À l’hôpital, même scénario que mardi dernier. En retard, on me reporte à demain. Prise de sang, puis un peu plus d’une heure d’attente pour les résultats.

nodes.source: Everything at an all time low today: neutrophils, platelets, red blood count and haemoglobin levels. This means 3 more GCSF injections at the end of the week, beginning Thursday. Bleomycin chemotherapy treatment tomorrow and, more significantly, I am to take on 2 units of blood on Thursday.
nodes.text: Tout au plus bas : neutrophiles, plaquettes, globules rouges et hémoglobine. Trois nouvelles injections de G-CSF dès jeudi, chimiothérapie à la bléomycine demain et surtout deux poches de sang jeudi.

nodes.source: Made my way home feeling tired and washed out. Not looking forward to tomorrow.
nodes.text: Retour fatigué et vidé. Je n’attends pas demain avec plaisir.

nodes.source: I wanted to go and see my Mum this evening but was just too tired to make it over to her house.
nodes.text: Je voulais voir ma mère ce soir, mais étais trop épuisé pour y aller.

nodes.source: Watched the box for a bit and retired to bed with my heart beating fast if I so much as moved a little.
nodes.text: Un peu de télévision, puis au lit, le cœur s’emballant au moindre mouvement.

nodes.source: 16th February 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 16 février 2005 - mercredi

nodes.source: Woke up feeling OK, although still tired. After another nose bleed and, feeling exhausted, I finally got myself together for the hospital.
nodes.text: Réveil correct, mais toujours fatigué. Encore un saignement de nez et l’épuisement, puis enfin prêt pour l’hôpital.

nodes.source: Once I arrived at the hospital, I was soon connected up for treatment. I didn't feel too bad and managed to stay quite lucid today, a big difference from last week's treatment.
nodes.text: Vite branché au traitement. Pas trop mal et assez lucide aujourd’hui, contrairement à la semaine dernière.

nodes.source: Had a big Subway sandwich for lunch, didn't fancy any of the hospital stuff and Ken collected it for me while he was out in Hammersmith. It was certainly a large sandwich so I made it last throughout the day. Experienced a bit of a stomach ache late afternoon. Not quite sure what this could be related to, could be the chemotherapy, could be the anti-sickness drugs or could be the sandwich!
nodes.text: Gros sandwich Subway pour déjeuner. Pas envie des plats de l’hôpital, Ken l’a cherché à Hammersmith. Assez gros pour durer toute la journée. Mal de ventre en fin d’après-midi : chimiothérapie, antiémétiques ou sandwich ?

nodes.source: By the end of the day, I was really starting to feel the side effects of the chemotherapy. Shivering and chills were the order of the day. Once I managed to get to the car, my teeth were chattering despite me being wrapped up really warm. The stomach ache was quite chronic at times.
nodes.text: En fin de journée, les effets secondaires se sont vraiment fait sentir : tremblements et frissons. Dans la voiture, les dents claquaient malgré mes vêtements chauds. Le ventre était parfois très douloureux.

nodes.source: My heart beat was very noticeable, too. I could hear every thrust of my heart and feel it all over my body. Due to my reduced red blood count and haemoglobin levels, my heart was compensating for the lack of oxygen being carried around my body by pumping harder and faster.
nodes.text: Je sentais aussi chaque battement du cœur dans tout mon corps. Avec si peu de globules rouges et d’hémoglobine, il compensait le manque d’oxygène en pompant plus fort et plus vite.

nodes.source: Reaching home, I was in a terrible state and hit the sofa, still with my coat on and covered myself with a duvet. After some sofa sleep I managed to get myself up to bed, my heart still racing. I could hardly breathe or see properly.
nodes.text: Rentré dans un état terrible, je me suis effondré sur le canapé, manteau encore sur moi, sous une couette. Après un peu de sommeil, j’ai pu gagner mon lit, le cœur toujours emballé. J’avais du mal à respirer et même à voir correctement.

nodes.source: I think some anxiety was mixed in to my state and I just couldn't get to sleep with the beating noise and rushing of blood in my body. Ken checked my stats (with a heart rate monitor I have) and my temperature; all seemed within tolerable limits and things settled a little for me to get off to sleep.
nodes.text: L’angoisse s’y mêlait probablement. Impossible de dormir avec ces battements et ce sang qui semblait se précipiter partout. Ken a vérifié mes constantes avec mon cardiofréquencemètre et pris ma température. Tout restait tolérable, puis cela s’est calmé assez pour dormir.

nodes.source: 17th February 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 17 février 2005 - jeudi

nodes.source: Woke up heart still beating fast; no time for anything this morning, so I just got ready in my poorly state and set off for the hospital. En route to the hospital today, I could hardly hold back the tears as I have just about had enough of all of this treatment, needles and hassle. Totally fed up is the feeling. I can see the light at the end of the tunnel but I'm rapidly nearing the end of my tether.
nodes.text: Réveil avec le cœur encore rapide. Pas le temps de faire quoi que ce soit : je me suis préparé tant bien que mal et suis parti. En route, je retenais à peine mes larmes. Traitements, aiguilles, complications : j’en ai assez. Je vois le bout du tunnel, mais je suis presque à bout.

nodes.source: So many ailments to cope with, along with the constant battering of treatment, is certainly dragging me down. I hope it will soon be over and I will be given a break to get back to full strength. My body has been ravaged by this cancer, now beaten into submission by the chemotherapy. The benefits of the chemotherapy far outweigh the side effects, it's just becoming a lot harder to deal with these days.
nodes.text: Tant de maux et ce bombardement constant de soins me minent. J’espère bientôt une pause pour retrouver mes forces. Mon corps a été ravagé par ce cancer, maintenant forcé à céder par la chimiothérapie. Ses bénéfices dépassent largement ses effets secondaires, mais les supporter devient beaucoup plus difficile.

nodes.source: I never anticipated or had been told at the beginning that there was a possibility of having a blood transfusion, despite it being a common treatment with chemotherapy patients. Typical of me to have a rare blood group, in fact the third rarest in the country according to the National Blood Service. I am AB+, this doesn't cause any problem, it's just there's not so much of it around as other more common blood types.
nodes.text: Je n’avais jamais envisagé une transfusion et on ne m’en avait pas parlé au départ, même si c’est courant sous chimiothérapie. Typique : j’ai un groupe rare, le troisième plus rare du pays selon le National Blood Service, AB+. Pas de problème particulier, simplement moins de réserves que pour les groupes courants.

nodes.source: Arrived at the hospital, still very washed out, heart beating fast, stomach mildly aching, exhausted and feeling quite upset. I managed to hold back the tears and got on with the events of the day.
nodes.text: Arrivé toujours vidé, cœur rapide, ventre douloureux, épuisé et bouleversé. J’ai retenu les larmes pour affronter la journée.

nodes.source: I was soon hooked up and the blood transfusion begun. No IV machine is used (it can damage the blood), the blood is kind of free flowed straight from the bag but slightly restricted to about one drip every two seconds. I had two bags of AB+ (about 600ml, just over a pint) specifically cross-matched. All arranged blood transfusions are. It took around 4-5 hours and I certainly felt a lot better at the end of it.
nodes.text: Vite branché pour la transfusion. Sans pompe, qui pourrait abîmer le sang : il coule directement de la poche, limité à environ une goutte toutes les deux secondes. Deux poches d’AB+, quelque 600 ml, un peu plus d’une pinte, spécialement testées pour la compatibilité, comme toutes les transfusions programmées. Quatre à cinq heures, et je me sentais nettement mieux.

nodes.source: If I am to suffer any side effects, they would be apparent quite quickly. My temperature and stats were checked regularly and all went smoothly.
nodes.text: Les réactions éventuelles se manifesteraient rapidement. Température et constantes contrôlées régulièrement, tout s’est bien passé.

nodes.source: Ken and I visited my favourite juice bar at Planet Organic in north London afterwards for a healthy smoothie and a shot of wheat grass! My stomach ache is still apparent but seems better.
nodes.text: Ensuite, mon bar à jus préféré, Planet Organic au nord de Londres, avec Ken : smoothie sain et dose de jus d’herbe de blé ! Le ventre fait encore mal, mais moins.

nodes.source: Now I'm home and looking forward to my final three days break. I'm feeling hungry so I'll have to conjure something up tonight. My Dad was due to visit but is not too well himself, flu, and I cannot be exposed to that.
nodes.text: À la maison pour mes trois derniers jours de pause. J’ai faim, il faudra préparer quelque chose. Mon père devait venir, mais il a la grippe et je ne peux pas y être exposé.

nodes.source: Over the past few days, and especially since my Wednesday chemotherapy, my chest seems to ache quite a bit, possibly my lungs reacting to the recent chemotherapy or the fact that my blood levels were at an all time low.
nodes.text: Ces derniers jours, surtout depuis la chimiothérapie de mercredi, ma poitrine est assez douloureuse. Peut-être mes poumons réagissent-ils au traitement, ou mes taux sanguins étaient-ils trop bas.

nodes.source: The transfusion today should perk me up quite a bit so, thanks to some kind soul giving some of their rare blood, I am to feel better quite soon and now understand the National Blood Services advert when they say "thanks to this person my relative's life was saved during their chemotherapy". Thanks whoever you are!
nodes.text: La transfusion devrait me requinquer. Grâce à quelqu’un qui a donné son sang rare, j’irai bientôt mieux. Je comprends maintenant la publicité du National Blood Service : « Grâce à cette personne, mon proche a été sauvé pendant sa chimiothérapie. » Merci, qui que vous soyez !

nodes.source: 18th February 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 18 février 2005 - vendredi

nodes.source: Woke up after a weird night's sleep. Got to bed at about midnight. My back and chest (lungs?) were aching quite substantially last night.
nodes.text: Nuit étrange, couché vers minuit. Le dos et la poitrine, les poumons peut-être, étaient très douloureux.

nodes.source: After dinner I managed to pop out briefly to surprise my Mum as she was out in a quiet local pub with my brother (thanks Martin). She was really surprised to see me turn up to have a quick soft drink with her and it made all the difference to me and I'm sure her spirits, too.
nodes.text: Après dîner, petite sortie surprise pour voir ma mère dans un pub tranquille avec mon frère, merci Martin. Elle ne s’attendait pas à me voir prendre un verre sans alcool avec elle. Cela nous a fait beaucoup de bien à tous les deux.

nodes.source: Last night was weird. When I went to bed my back was aching quite severely, right at the bottom of my spine and it felt like it was deep inside the bone. I could hardly get off to sleep and awoke at 02.30 in excruciating pain. I had to take 2 paracetamols and, once the pain was suppressed, I drifted off to sleep. Woke up several times after that, sweating badly. All in all, not a brilliant night's sleep, however I am feeling reasonably OK today.
nodes.text: Au coucher, terrible douleur en bas de la colonne, comme au fond de l’os. Difficile de m’endormir, puis réveil à 2 h 30 avec une douleur atroce. Deux paracétamols l’ont calmée et j’ai redormi, avec plusieurs réveils en sueur. Pas une grande nuit, mais je vais raisonnablement bien aujourd’hui.

nodes.source: The blood transfusion has obviously done a good job as I certainly feel a bit closer to normal again, certainly versus the last few days. I've had a very lazy morning and enjoyed a large bowl of cereal for breakfast.
nodes.text: La transfusion a manifestement aidé : je me sens plus proche de la normale que ces derniers jours. Matinée très paresseuse et grand bol de céréales.

nodes.source: I'll take it easy today, I fancy getting out a bit later so will eat well and have a long overdue relaxing bath before I decide what to do.
nodes.text: Repos aujourd’hui. J’aimerais sortir plus tard ; d’abord bien manger et prendre un bain relaxant depuis longtemps attendu.

nodes.source: Didn't feel like doing anything today so lounged around after my bath. Ate some lunch then some soup for dinner because I just didn't have the energy for anything else.
nodes.text: Finalement, envie de rien, j’ai traîné après le bain. Déjeuner puis soupe au dîner, faute d’énergie pour autre chose.

nodes.source: Just have to postpone what I wanted to do today until tomorrow. As long as I can conjure up the energy!
nodes.text: Je reporte mes projets à demain, si je trouve l’énergie !

nodes.source: Going to bed very soon!
nodes.text: Au lit très bientôt !

nodes.source: 19th February 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 19 février 2005 - samedi

nodes.source: Last night's sleep wasn't bad although I did wake up once, suddenly, in the early hours. No idea what that was about.
nodes.text: Nuit pas mauvaise, malgré un réveil soudain aux petites heures. Aucune idée pourquoi.

nodes.source: A bit sluggish this morning, but managed to get moving and arranged with a friend to take a drive to visit the Masonic shop in Great Queen Street, London. Quite a journey for me! Picked up some bits for an important ceremony on the 26th, one day after my upcoming treatment. I hope to be there!!
nodes.text: Au ralenti, mais j’ai réussi à m’activer et prévu avec un ami d’aller à la boutique maçonnique de Great Queen Street, à Londres. Une expédition ! Achats pour une cérémonie importante le 26, le lendemain du prochain traitement. J’espère pouvoir y être !!

nodes.source: Made my way back, with a quick visit to B&Q and McDonalds. Sat around at my friend's house for a while then head for home briefly before setting off to see my Mum for the evening.
nodes.text: Retour avec un passage à B&Q et McDonald’s. Un moment chez mon ami, bref retour chez moi, puis soirée chez ma mère.

nodes.source: A hectic day by my current standards, but I achieved all I needed and should sleep well tonight. I haven't managed to eat a very healthy dinner tonight, I'm out of energy and am home quite late. Soup again!
nodes.text: Une journée chargée à mon échelle actuelle, mais tout est fait et je devrais bien dormir. Pas de dîner très sain : rentré tard, sans énergie, encore une soupe !

nodes.source: All in all, a good day, although tiring. I just don't seem to have the energy I used to have and am certainly feeling weaker in my arms and legs. No wonder, when I haven't really done much at all in the last 2 and a half months!
nodes.text: Bonne journée, quoique fatigante. Je n’ai plus mon énergie habituelle et mes bras et jambes sont plus faibles. Pas étonnant après deux mois et demi à presque rien faire !

nodes.source: 20th February 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 20 février 2005 - dimanche

nodes.source: From today the following entries were not made in this diary until the 15th March 2005, due to circumstances that will become apparent as you read on...
nodes.text: À partir d’ici, les entrées n’ont été écrites que le 15 mars 2005, pour des raisons que la suite vous expliquera...

nodes.source: A good sleep and once up I made arrangements to have Sunday lunch with my friend at his Mum's house.
nodes.text: Bonne nuit, puis organisation d’un déjeuner dominical avec mon ami chez sa mère.

nodes.source: Time soon passed and I was at my friend's Mum's for dinner, she's 75 and certainly cooks a mean Sunday roast which I thoroughly enjoyed along with a massive fruit salad for afters, yummy.
nodes.text: Le temps a filé. À 75 ans, sa mère prépare un fameux rôti du dimanche, que j’ai savouré, suivi d’une énorme salade de fruits. Délicieux.

nodes.source: Over to my Mum's to spend time with her before my 5 day stay in hospital beginning tomorrow. Picked up some clean clothes I needed and headed home apprehensively, fighting hospital thoughts from my head!
nodes.text: Puis chez ma mère avant les cinq jours d’hôpital commençant demain. Vêtements propres récupérés, retour inquiet, en essayant de chasser l’hôpital de mes pensées !

nodes.source: 21st February 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 21 février 2005 - lundi

nodes.source: Arrived at hospital in good time today. I know the routine, so got my general admission out of the way, blood test and X-Ray.
nodes.text: Arrivé à temps. Je connais la routine : admission, prise de sang et radiographie.

nodes.source: Met up with Milton and nipped over the road for a Pizza Express with him and Ken. Straight back to hospital afterwards and awaited my cannulation and treatment start time.
nodes.text: Retrouvé Milton, puis Pizza Express de l’autre côté de la rue avec lui et Ken. Retour immédiat pour attendre le cathéter et le traitement.

nodes.source: Confirmation came today about my final treatment cycle, the Bleomycin chemotherapy drug was to be cut out of my schedule. My lungs have shown significant improvement (the cancer cells have shrunk to almost non existent). Any more of the 'B' part of my treatment would only damage my lungs further. So this is my FINAL week of chemotherapy, no more required, no outpatient chemotherapy visits anymore. A sobering thought and certainly something to focus on as a positive landmark in my overall treatment. Having goals, however small, has helped make things easier going throughout and almost sped up the times I've wanted to forget about so quickly!
nodes.text: Confirmation pour le dernier cycle : suppression de la bléomycine. Mes poumons se sont nettement améliorés, les cellules cancéreuses ayant presque disparu. Continuer le « B » ne ferait que les abîmer davantage. C’est donc ma DERNIÈRE semaine de chimiothérapie, plus de traitement ni de séances ambulatoires ensuite. Une pensée qui donne à réfléchir et un cap positif sur lequel me concentrer. Même petits, les objectifs rendent les choses plus faciles et accélèrent presque ces périodes que je veux vite oublier !

nodes.source: Treatment began quite late however, due to the 'B' part of my chemotherapy being cut out, it would only mean 9 hours of treatment each day.
nodes.text: Début tardif, mais sans le « B », seulement neuf heures de traitement par jour.

nodes.source: Not much sleep tonight, being a veteran of chemotherapy, 3 full cycles previous, I was used to this and handled it in my stride!
nodes.text: Peu dormi. Après trois cycles complets, je suis un vétéran et prends cela avec philosophie !

nodes.source: 22nd February 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 22 février 2005 - mardi

nodes.source: Free of my IV machine in the early hours of this morning, I managed to get up and about for a bit today. I notified the nurses of a time that would suit me to begin my next treatment. They were happy to do this and I made best use of the time I had to myself.
nodes.text: Libéré de la machine aux petites heures, j’ai pu me lever. J’ai indiqué aux infirmières une heure convenable pour la prochaine séance. Elles ont accepté et j’ai profité de mon temps libre.

nodes.source: This evening, I started to get nauseous and the chemotherapy was starting to take its toll on me a lot earlier than I had remembered from previous weeks.
nodes.text: Ce soir, les nausées commencent et la chimiothérapie m’éprouve bien plus tôt que les autres semaines.

nodes.source: 23rd February 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 23 février 2005 - mercredi

nodes.source: Woke up free from IV again, a slightly better night's sleep but chemotherapy still did not end until the early hours. Sleep certainly does not seem to be important in terms of treatment in hospital, I always thought that it was the time that your body rejuvenated and recovered best!?
nodes.text: Réveil de nouveau sans perfusion. Un peu mieux dormi, mais traitement terminé encore aux petites heures. Le sommeil ne semble pas prioritaire à l’hôpital, alors que je croyais que le corps récupérait surtout ainsi !?

nodes.source: Still feeling extremely nauseous today.
nodes.text: Toujours extrêmement nauséeux.

nodes.source: I was asked if I could be a dummy patient, like an actor in a given situation. As this helps to pass the time of day in an interesting manner, I readily agreed. I was to be told -hypothetically of course- that I was Hepatitis C positive by a trainee doctor who needed to practise their patient communication skills before an exam.
nodes.text: On m’a proposé de jouer un patient fictif. Une façon intéressante de passer le temps, j’ai accepté. Un médecin en formation devait m’annoncer, hypothétiquement, une hépatite C positive pour travailler sa communication avant un examen.

nodes.source: It was fun (I don't think in reality it would be much fun) playing the part and to be honest the news was broken to me a little bit abruptly and could have been a little smoother. I asked all the questions I think someone in my given situation would do in order to make it as real as possible for the trainee.
nodes.text: Amusant de jouer ce rôle, même si ce ne le serait pas en vrai. Franchement, l’annonce était un peu brutale et aurait pu être plus douce. J’ai posé toutes les questions qu’une personne dans cette situation poserait, pour rendre l’exercice réaliste.

nodes.source: I retired to bed shortly after. I haven't eaten much at all so far, Monday was the last day I really ate a decent meal. The sheer thought of treatment, the environment, the smells, everything makes me feel sick!
nodes.text: Retour au lit peu après. J’ai très peu mangé ; mon dernier vrai repas remonte à lundi. La pensée du traitement, l’environnement, les odeurs : tout me donne la nausée !

nodes.source: Ken has visited from late afternoon onwards. Having someone around makes a great difference to time spent in hospital. I am very lucky to have had people I know around me most of the time. Other patients look lonely and left without visitors for days, perhaps it's what they wanted; I know I would have certainly felt a void if faced with the time on my own.
nodes.text: Ken est là depuis la fin d’après-midi. Être accompagné change tout à l’hôpital. J’ai la chance de presque toujours avoir des proches. D’autres semblent seuls, sans visiteurs pendant des jours. Peut-être le souhaitent-ils, mais j’aurais certainement ressenti un grand vide.

nodes.source: chemotherapy started a little after the time I requested. Another "into the night" treatment schedule ahead.
nodes.text: Chimiothérapie commencée un peu après l’heure demandée. Encore un traitement qui se prolonge dans la nuit.

nodes.source: Stayed in bed for the rest of the day and, in the evening, managed some water melon Ken had brought along. It didn't stay down for long, I will not go into detail!
nodes.text: Resté au lit. Le soir, un peu de pastèque apportée par Ken. Elle n’est pas restée longtemps, je vous épargne les détails !

nodes.source: 24th February 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 24 février 2005 - jeudi

nodes.source: Another late chemotherapy finish (early hours). Nausea much, much more apparent today and retching with sickness was the order of the day. The anti sickness drugs are not working so well for me this week, most likely to do with the fact that I cannot keep even them down for long.
nodes.text: Fin encore aux petites heures. Beaucoup plus de nausées aujourd’hui, avec haut-le-cœur et vomissements. Les antiémétiques marchent moins cette semaine, probablement parce que même eux ne restent pas dans mon estomac.

nodes.source: Stayed in bed all day, getting up only to visit the loo. Being sick wasn't pleasant with nothing inside me to actually be sick with, my only comfort being that I didn't have to jump up and run for the loo; I had stocked up on the cardboard throw away hospital sickness bowls!
nodes.text: Toute la journée au lit, sauf les toilettes. Vomir à vide est pénible. Ma seule consolation : pas besoin de courir, j’avais fait des réserves de haricots en carton jetables !

nodes.source: I did manage 2 bowls of cornflakes without milk tonight. It was really the only thing I could think of that I fancied and they actually stayed inside me somewhere never to be seen again!
nodes.text: Deux bols de cornflakes sans lait ce soir. La seule chose qui me tentait, et ils sont restés quelque part en moi sans jamais reparaître !

nodes.source: Late start on the chemotherapy again, slightly later than I had requested but earlier than previous days, my first decent night's sleep was due. This slightly comforting thought was soon demolished as chemotherapy bag changes and delays (the nurses were extremely busy today and low in numbers) took my chemotherapy completion in to the early hours again.
nodes.text: Encore un début tardif, après l’heure demandée mais plus tôt que les jours précédents. Je pensais enfin bien dormir. Espoir vite anéanti : changements de poches et retards, les infirmières étant débordées et en sous-effectif, ont encore repoussé la fin aux petites heures.

nodes.source: 25th February 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 25 février 2005 - vendredi

nodes.source: My last chemotherapy day. A wonderful thought but I had no energy and felt so sick I could hardly break a smile.
nodes.text: Dernier jour de chimiothérapie. Merveilleux, mais trop faible et nauséeux pour même sourire.

nodes.source: Another day in bed, my friend came early today and kept my spirits up although I did sleep quite a bit so wasn't much company in return. In fact on reflection sleep was definitely a regular occurrence during the days this week, catching the odd hour here and there whenever I could.
nodes.text: Encore au lit. Mon amie est venue tôt me remonter le moral, mais je dormais beaucoup et n’étais pas très bonne compagnie. En y repensant, j’ai dormi par petites heures toute cette semaine, dès que possible.

nodes.source: Chemotherapy started a lot later than I would have liked. 6 West was a very busy ward this week and rumours were rife that it was to stay open for the weekend. Well I never, what a turn up for the books, I remember a time when I was the only patient left on the ward and they couldn't wait to get rid of me. Today I was even offered an extra night in the hospital if I wanted. What do you think I said to that? This was possibly to be the last ever day I had to spend in hospital and I couldn't wait to get away!!
nodes.text: Début bien plus tard que souhaité. Le service 6 West est débordé ; on dit qu’il restera ouvert le week-end. Quelle nouveauté ! Je me souviens d’avoir été le dernier patient dont ils voulaient se débarrasser. On m’a même proposé une nuit supplémentaire. Devinez ma réponse ! C’était peut-être mon dernier jour d’hôpital et j’avais hâte de fuir !!

nodes.source: Finally, chemotherapy finished around 7 or 8pm and after a struggle I was dressed and almost ready to go. One last big heave and I was sick for the last and final time in hospital. I was sick what must have been a record number of times this week, I really do not want to remember how I felt.
nodes.text: Enfin terminé vers 19 ou 20 h. J’ai péniblement réussi à m’habiller. Un dernier haut-le-cœur et dernier vomissement à l’hôpital. Un nombre probablement record cette semaine. Je ne veux vraiment pas me souvenir de cet état.

nodes.source: Ken took me home, I fell asleep on the sofa and eventually got up to bed in the early hours.
nodes.text: Ken m’a ramené. Endormi sur le canapé, puis monté au lit aux petites heures.

nodes.source: 26th February 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 26 février 2005 - samedi

nodes.source: Ken came in to my room to say farewell early this morning as he was off on a short break to see his family for a while. I slept in for a while afterwards.
nodes.text: Ken est venu me dire au revoir tôt avant une petite visite à sa famille. J’ai encore dormi après.

nodes.source: So I was up around 12pm and a friend had arrived to look after me and keep me company until Sunday.
nodes.text: Debout vers midi, avec l’arrivée d’une amie pour s’occuper de moi jusqu’à dimanche.

nodes.source: Masonic ceremony day today, I really wanted to be able to attend as this was an important goal for me to achieve following my treatment. After all, I had bought all the bits I needed the previous Saturday and somehow had managed to learn some important lines in between being sick and chemotherapy!
nodes.text: Cérémonie maçonnique aujourd’hui, un objectif important après le traitement. J’avais acheté le nécessaire samedi dernier et réussi à apprendre mon texte entre vomissements et chimiothérapie !

nodes.source: Found the energy from somewhere, got myself smartly dressed and left my house around 2.30pm.
nodes.text: J’ai trouvé des forces, me suis bien habillé et suis parti vers 14 h 30.

nodes.source: I took it very easy indeed, was extremely glad I had made it out, completed my part of a lengthy ceremony word perfectly and even managed to stay for the meal afterwards. I picked at the food but made a good effort to get some of it inside me.
nodes.text: Je me suis vraiment ménagé. Heureux d’être sorti, j’ai récité sans faute ma partie de cette longue cérémonie et suis même resté au repas. J’ai picoré, mais fait l’effort d’avaler quelque chose.

nodes.source: When the meal had finished, I was very tired after a long day and soon went to bed once home.
nodes.text: Après le repas et cette longue journée, très fatigué, je me suis vite couché au retour.

nodes.source: 27th February 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 27 février 2005 - dimanche

nodes.source: Woke up quite early today but soon retired back to bed and didn't get up until about 3pm!!
nodes.text: Réveil assez tôt, mais retour au lit jusqu’à 15 h !!

nodes.source: Although in and out of sleep for most of the day I managed to watch some TV and, more importantly, eat a little food!
nodes.text: Entre deux sommes, j’ai regardé la télévision et surtout réussi à manger un peu !

nodes.source: My friend decided to stay at my house another night and leave in the morning. My Dad is due to arrive late morning to stay with me for the week ahead.
nodes.text: Mon amie reste une nuit supplémentaire et part demain matin. Mon père arrivera en fin de matinée pour rester la semaine.

nodes.source: Despite sleeping for a good majority of the day, I still felt really tired tonight. Once I made sure my friend had everything she needed and was comfortable I retired to bed for another full night's sleep.
nodes.text: Malgré presque toute la journée de sommeil, encore épuisé ce soir. Après m’être assuré que mon amie avait tout et était bien installée, retour au lit pour une nouvelle nuit complète.

nodes.source: 28th February 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 28 février 2005 - lundi

nodes.source: Shortly after getting up, my Dad arrived.
nodes.text: Mon père est arrivé peu après mon lever.

nodes.source: Spent the day catching up with my Dad and, although weak, managed to eat a little and start to plan my week ahead, starting with a blood test tomorrow.
nodes.text: Journée avec mon père pour rattraper les nouvelles. Malgré la faiblesse, j’ai mangé un peu et commencé à organiser la semaine, avec une prise de sang demain.

nodes.source: There is so much I want to do but just cannot motivate myself to do it, the truth is I just don't have the energy yet. It annoys me that there are things I want to do but just cannot muster the energy to do them. This chemotherapy in my system is going to take some serious flushing for me to get back to anywhere near normal.
nodes.text: Tant de choses me tentent, mais impossible de me motiver : je n’ai simplement pas l’énergie. C’est frustrant de vouloir sans pouvoir. Il faudra vraiment éliminer cette chimiothérapie de mon organisme avant de retrouver quelque chose de normal.

nodes.source: March 2005
nodes.text: Mars 2005

nodes.source: 1st March 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 1 mars 2005 - mardi

nodes.source: Got to Charing X about an hour late for my blood test. My Dad accompanied me to the hospital and joined me for a chat with my Doctor. Routine discussions; my treatment has progressed well, now it's recovery time for my body before any operations are carried out.
nodes.text: Arrivé à Charing Cross une heure en retard pour le sang. Mon père m’accompagnait pour parler au médecin. Discussion habituelle : traitement bien avancé, maintenant repos du corps avant les opérations.

nodes.source: Spent a considerable amount of time wandering about on the 6th floor catching up with Milton and the staff while waiting for my blood test results. Once they were finally through, I managed to grab the registrar on the 6th floor to discuss them.
nodes.text: Longue attente au 6e étage avec Milton et le personnel. Résultats enfin arrivés, j’ai trouvé le médecin pour en discuter.

nodes.source: My blood health is low but that is to be expected. I wasn't planning on doing anything apart from recovering at home, so the registrar didn't recommend any further medication or injections and gave me a cautionary chat about looking after myself and allowed me to go home.
nodes.text: Bilan bas, comme attendu. Comme je ne comptais que récupérer chez moi, pas de médicament ni d’injection supplémentaire. Conseils de prudence, puis autorisation de partir.

nodes.source: A quick visit to the local DIY store en route home.
nodes.text: Petite visite au magasin de bricolage en rentrant.

nodes.source: Once home, managed a little dinner and relaxed in front of the TV before hitting the sack.
nodes.text: Un peu de dîner, télévision, puis au lit.

nodes.source: 2nd March 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 2 mars 2005 - mercredi

nodes.source: Woke up not really feeling refreshed at all. Managed to get myself up and dressed but not much more. A little breakfast and I hit the sofa for the rest of the day.
nodes.text: Réveil sans sensation de repos. Levé et habillé, pas beaucoup plus. Petit-déjeuner léger, puis canapé toute la journée.

nodes.source: Often snoozing, I found that if I tried to motivate myself to do anything I would just get out of breath and my heart would beat faster and harder.
nodes.text: Souvent assoupi. Au moindre effort, essoufflement et cœur qui bat plus vite et plus fort.

nodes.source: If I were to mark my health and how I feel out of 10, I'd say I was at about a 6.
nodes.text: Si je notais mon état sur dix, environ six.

nodes.source: 3rd March 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 3 mars 2005 - jeudi

nodes.source: Much the same as yesterday; spent the day on the sofa. My little health marker I've made up in my head is still at about a 6.
nodes.text: Comme hier, canapé. Mon petit indicateur mental reste autour de six.

nodes.source: 4th March 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 4 mars 2005 - vendredi

nodes.source: Still much the same, spent the day on the sofa feeling very lethargic indeed. My little health marker now at about 5.
nodes.text: Toujours pareil, journée au canapé très léthargique. Mon indicateur est maintenant autour de cinq.

nodes.source: 5th March 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 5 mars 2005 - samedi

nodes.source: Still much the same, spent the day on the sofa. Sleeping lots and getting tired very quickly, even if I attempt to move about too much on the sofa. My little health marker still at about a 5.
nodes.text: Toujours pareil, journée sur le canapé. Je dors beaucoup et me fatigue au moindre mouvement, même assis. Mon indicateur reste à cinq.

nodes.source: 6th March 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 6 mars 2005 - dimanche

nodes.source: Still much the same, spent the day on the sofa. Sleeping lots and getting tired very quickly, even if I attempt to move about too much on the sofa.
nodes.text: Toujours pareil, sur le canapé, à beaucoup dormir et me fatiguer au moindre mouvement.

nodes.source: Very frustrating indeed, there's so much I want to achieve and even the smallest things seem like too much of a chore.
nodes.text: Très frustrant : tant de choses à faire, et la moindre tâche paraît énorme.

nodes.source: One thing I really wanted to do was get to see my Mum today, being Mother's Day. It just wasn't going to happen; I could not muster the energy to even lift myself from the sofa. This made me quite disappointed indeed.
nodes.text: Je voulais surtout voir ma mère pour la fête des Mères. Impossible de trouver la force de quitter le canapé. Très déçu.

nodes.source: I have been eating, but sporadically, and there really hasn't been much I've particularly fancied at all. Still, my Dad has persevered and managed to get me to eat a decent meal each night.
nodes.text: Je mange de façon irrégulière, sans envie particulière. Mon père persévère et me fait prendre un vrai repas chaque soir.

nodes.source: My little health marker now at about a 4. I reckon I'm most certainly due for a blood transfusion this coming week and said as much to my Dad.
nodes.text: Mon indicateur descend à quatre. J’ai dit à mon père qu’une transfusion me semblait inévitable la semaine prochaine.

nodes.source: 7th March 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 7 mars 2005 - lundi

nodes.source: My Dad left early this morning for his home, after spending the whole of last week looking after me. Also fitting in quite a bit of DIY that needed doing too!
nodes.text: Mon père est reparti tôt après une semaine à s’occuper de moi et à faire du bricolage nécessaire.

nodes.source: I rested and slept on the sofa for the rest of the day.
nodes.text: Repos et sommeil sur le canapé le reste de la journée.

nodes.source: I reckon health marker probably at a 3 by now!
nodes.text: Je dois être à trois maintenant !

nodes.source: 8th March 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 8 mars 2005 - mardi

nodes.source: Got myself moving this morning, I really don't know where I found the energy from. Drove myself in to Charing Cross for my blood test.
nodes.text: J’ai trouvé je ne sais où la force de me préparer et conduire jusqu’à Charing Cross pour le sang.

nodes.source: Spoke with the registrar immediately after bloods were taken and nipped up to the 6th floor to see who was about while waiting for my results.
nodes.text: Discussion avec le médecin après le prélèvement, puis montée au 6e voir qui était là pendant l’attente.

nodes.source: I knew I wasn't feeling well but once I returned for my results at Clinic 8, I was told that I wasn't going home and was to be admitted - to an isolation room!!!
nodes.text: Je me savais mal, mais les résultats à la clinique 8 ont changé la journée : pas de retour chez moi, hospitalisation en isolement !!!

nodes.source: My blood health was so poor I was in quite a bit of danger. Black outs, internal bleeding, serious infections; to mention some of the possible things that could have happened to me if my blood and I were left alone to get any worse!
nodes.text: Mon sang était en si mauvais état que je risquais malaises, hémorragies internes et infections graves, si on me laissait encore décliner !

nodes.source: It seems the cumulative effects of my chemotherapy had really kicked in and my bone marrow was simply not functioning correctly enough to produce goodness for my blood.
nodes.text: Les effets cumulés de la chimiothérapie semblent s’être déclarés : ma moelle osseuse ne produit plus suffisamment de bonnes cellules sanguines.

nodes.source: After waiting 6 hours for my room to be allocated (a friend had arrived to keep me company) I was moved up to the familiar 6th floor, this time on the North wing in to a room of my very own.
nodes.text: Six heures d’attente pour une chambre, avec un ami venu me tenir compagnie, puis le 6e étage familier, aile Nord, dans ma propre chambre.

nodes.source: 1 GCSF injection and immediately on Antibiotics (Amoxicillin 500mg).
nodes.text: Une injection de G-CSF et antibiotiques immédiats, amoxicilline 500 mg.

nodes.source: Cannulated twice, the first time failed, eventually the first unit of blood to be transfused was begun. Following which I was transfused 1 pool of platelets and then a following further 2 units of blood. All this would go through the night and my observations were carried out at very close intervals due to the feverish side effects both blood and platelets can give you. No sleep for me!
nodes.text: Deux poses de cathéter, la première ratée, puis première poche de sang. Ensuite un pool de plaquettes, puis deux autres poches. Toute la nuit, avec contrôles rapprochés à cause des réactions fébriles possibles. Pas de sommeil !

nodes.source: Together with some friends, I managed to get some clothes and my usual hospital gear brought to me this evening. Remember I only drove in for a blood test earlier and was not expecting to be admitted!
nodes.text: Des amis ont apporté vêtements et matériel habituel. Je n’étais venu que pour une prise de sang, sans prévoir de rester !

nodes.source: I was sick this evening. Not sure why, may have been the stress of coming back in unexpectedly or simply just the ongoing effects of my poor state of health.
nodes.text: J’ai vomi ce soir. Stress de ce retour inattendu ou mauvais état général ?

nodes.source: Being in isolation meant strict hygiene and contact with others was at a minimum.
nodes.text: L’isolement impose une hygiène stricte et des contacts minimaux.

nodes.source: 9th March 2005 - Wednesday
nodes.text: 9 mars 2005 - mercredi

nodes.source: Three months since diagnosis today. It passed without me noticing.
nodes.text: Trois mois depuis le diagnostic, sans que je le remarque.

nodes.source: I slept for a fair bit today. Someone came over to visit, I doubt I was much company.
nodes.text: Beaucoup dormi. Une visite, mais je n’étais sûrement pas bonne compagnie.

nodes.source: They took another blood test, a very slight improvement. Another 1 unit of blood was required, managed to get this in during the evening and was left alone for a good night's sleep.
nodes.text: Nouvelle analyse, amélioration minime. Encore une poche de sang le soir, puis enfin une vraie nuit tranquille.

nodes.source: 10th March 2005 - Thursday
nodes.text: 10 mars 2005 - jeudi

nodes.source: Slept really well. Observation day today, if no improvement is found in the level of my platelets today, another pool of platelets will be required.
nodes.text: Très bien dormi. Observation aujourd’hui ; si les plaquettes ne montent pas, nouveau pool nécessaire.

nodes.source: Fortunately my bloods had recovered suitably well enough for me to just be observed for the day.
nodes.text: Heureusement, les résultats se sont assez améliorés pour simplement me surveiller.

nodes.source: My health had certainly picked up a lot more today and spent most of it in bed watching daytime TV!
nodes.text: Bien mieux aujourd’hui, passé surtout au lit devant la télévision !

nodes.source: No need for isolation hygiene requirements anymore. I was free to leave the room and take more visitors. A few visitors came over this evening after which I got myself another brilliant and undisturbed night's sleep.
nodes.text: Fin des règles d’isolement. Libre de sortir et de recevoir davantage. Quelques visiteurs, puis une autre excellente nuit ininterrompue.

nodes.source: 11th March 2005 - Friday
nodes.text: 11 mars 2005 - vendredi

nodes.source: Slept really well again and felt so much better.
nodes.text: Encore très bien dormi, et tellement mieux.

nodes.source: Stuck the daytime TV on, observations taken. I eagerly awaited my blood test today as the results would determine whether I was to be discharged.
nodes.text: Télévision et constantes. J’attends vivement la prise de sang, décisive pour ma sortie.

nodes.source: I waited some time for my blood test to be taken. The ward was quite busy today as I think they had a very poorly patient whom I had seen them rushing an emergency crash cart to. During my short stay this week I had seen many distressed relatives. Death is something which you become almost oblivious to, especially spending time on a Cancer ward, you know it's happening but shield yourself from the suffering.
nodes.text: Longue attente, service chargé et patient très malade auquel on a apporté un chariot de réanimation. J’ai vu beaucoup de familles bouleversées cette semaine. Dans un service de cancérologie, la mort finit presque par passer à l’arrière-plan : on sait, mais on se protège de la souffrance.

nodes.source: I waited patiently and carried on with my new daytime TV addiction.
nodes.text: J’attends patiemment avec ma nouvelle addiction à la télévision de journée.

nodes.source: Finally the registrar decided to do the blood test, as I had not been seen to for ages. They were marked urgent and I awaited the results.
nodes.text: Le médecin a fini par me prélever lui-même, devant cette attente. Analyse urgente, résultats attendus.

nodes.source: Everything apart from my Magnesium levels had returned to reasonable levels and I was to be discharged as soon as my cannulation was removed and my TTA (To Take Away) medications allocated. Apparently the TTA's were already ready but due to how busy the ward was today, I waited a further 5 hours to be discharged (I think they had thought I'd already left or had forgotten about me. Instead I was happily laying in bed watching the box and chatting to a friend who had been with me for the whole day).
nodes.text: Tout revenu à des niveaux raisonnables sauf le magnésium. Sortie dès le retrait du cathéter et les médicaments à emporter. Déjà prêts, apparemment, mais cinq heures de plus avec le service débordé. Peut-être me croyaient-ils parti ou m’avaient-ils oublié. Moi, au lit, je regardais tranquillement la télévision avec un ami présent toute la journée.

nodes.source: My Magnesium deficiency is down to the damage that the Cisplatin or the 'P' of BEP chemotherapy has done to my body. This is something that will now have to be monitored carefully during each of my blood tests although the doctors do not seem to be overly concerned. There is so much, outside of killing cancer, that chemotherapy does to your body. Killing cancer cells is the desired result, the rest just has to be dealt with as and when it becomes apparent.
nodes.text: Le manque de magnésium vient des dégâts du cisplatine, le « P » du BEP. À contrôler dans chaque analyse, même si les médecins ne semblent pas très inquiets. La chimio fait tellement plus que tuer les cellules cancéreuses. C’est le résultat voulu ; le reste doit être géré à mesure qu’il apparaît.

nodes.source: I left the hospital at exactly the time I thought I would, right in the thick of the rush hour on a Friday night heading out of London. It was not good.
nodes.text: Sorti exactement au pire moment : l’heure de pointe du vendredi pour quitter Londres. Pas agréable.

nodes.source: Once home, I relaxed in front of the TV, ate a huge 2 helpings of chicken and pasta for dinner which someone kindly prepared for me and soon retired for the evening.
nodes.text: À la maison, télévision et deux grosses portions de poulet et pâtes gentiment préparées, puis coucher rapide.

nodes.source: 12th March 2005 - Saturday
nodes.text: 12 mars 2005 - samedi

nodes.source: No entries for today.
nodes.text: Aucune entrée aujourd’hui.

nodes.source: 13th March 2005 - Sunday
nodes.text: 13 mars 2005 - dimanche

nodes.source: No entries for today.
nodes.text: Aucune entrée aujourd’hui.

nodes.source: 14th March 2005 - Monday
nodes.text: 14 mars 2005 - lundi

nodes.source: No entries for today.
nodes.text: Aucune entrée aujourd’hui.

nodes.source: 15th March 2005 - Tuesday
nodes.text: 15 mars 2005 - mardi

nodes.source: I'm back!
nodes.text: Me revoilà !

nodes.source: I've updated some of my missing diary entries as best as I can remember them (more to follow soon), right back until the 20th February 2005 and, after a lot of typing, hope you enjoy the read! Apologies for not keeping you all posted on my progress recently, I have been weak at times, convalescing at others. I was sure you'd understand and know your thoughts and prayers were with me during what has been one of the tougher times for me.
nodes.text: J’ai complété de mémoire les journées manquantes depuis le 20 février, d’autres suivront. Beaucoup tapé, bonne lecture ! Désolé du silence : faible parfois, en récupération à d’autres moments. Je savais que vous comprendriez et que vos pensées et prières m’accompagnaient dans cette période difficile.

nodes.source: Woke up after a long sleep and readied myself for my hospital visit, hopefully today they'll let me go home!
nodes.text: Longue nuit puis préparation pour l’hôpital. Espérons qu’aujourd’hui ils me laisseront rentrer !

nodes.source: A friend has been staying at my house looking after me for sometime now, it's nice not to have to spend the time at home alone and to have someone around reminding me to eat and helping me with cooking etc.
nodes.text: Un ami séjourne chez moi pour s’occuper de moi. Agréable de ne pas rester seul, d’avoir des rappels pour manger et de l’aide en cuisine.

nodes.source: A quick breakfast and some orange juice and my friend and I sped off to the hospital.
nodes.text: Petit-déjeuner rapide et jus d’orange, puis départ ensemble.

nodes.source: Arrived at Charing Cross Clinic 8 on the 1st floor for my blood test, whilst waiting for the results made myself busy visiting Milton, some other fellow patients and staff up on the 6th floor.
nodes.text: Prélèvement à la clinique 8 au 1er étage. Pendant l’attente, visites à Milton, aux autres patients et au personnel au 6e.

nodes.source: After about 2 hours, I went down to get my results and had a chat with the registrar. My general blood health is on the up, with most of the individual readings from my blood looking more positive than the previous week. Simply put, that means my blood health is not quite at its best but certainly looking like it's heading in the right direction.
nodes.text: Deux heures après, résultats et discussion : bilan général en hausse, presque toutes les valeurs meilleures que la semaine dernière. Pas encore optimal, mais dans la bonne direction.

nodes.source: In order for me to be ready for any operation, my blood health must be much better than it currently is. The doctors will simply not operate if there is a chance of me getting an infection or not being able to fully bounce back from surgery.
nodes.text: Avant toute opération, mon sang doit être bien meilleur. Les médecins n’opéreront pas avec un risque d’infection ou une incapacité à bien récupérer.

nodes.source: Day by day now, I'm feeling better, trying to do more and more without overdoing it. I've been out to see my Mum for the first time in ages and have been to the supermarket to top up on my shopping.
